description: Capability for the limits strip window (undecorated, transparent, always on top, pinned to a screen edge). Kept minimal: the strip drags itself and listens on `limits://state`, `limits://prefs` and `limits://chime`; sizing, parking and closing go through the limits_strip_* commands. Application commands are not gated by capabilities, but the event listener is, so `core:event:default` is spelled out here rather than inherited silently from `core:default`.
